name: South Luangwa
about: Dry season (May–Oct) concentrates wildlife along the rivers and is prime walking-safari season; wet season brings migratory birds but muddier trails.
overview: The birthplace of the walking safari — one of Africa's best, least-crowded game-viewing experiences, with Victoria Falls reachable via Livingstone as an optional add-on.
costOverview: A plate of nshima stays inexpensive throughout — guided walking safaris and bush-camp stays are the real, near-mandatory cost here.
monthlyWeather: hot and wet, deep in the rainy season with muddy trails but strong bird activity
